title: Pen-mode pointer cancel e2e test fails intermittently with object reference chain is too long
reason: The failing test returns the Editor instance from `page.evaluate`, requiring Playwright to serialize a deeply connected object graph; the report concerns test code, not pen cancellation behavior. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve's E2E interaction tests expose narrow scalar inspection hooks and do not return the editor object across Playwright's protocol. This test-serialization failure has no local product analogue.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's E2E interaction tests expose narrow scalar inspection hooks and do not return the editor object across Playwright's protocol.

title: Select-drag pointer cancel e2e test reads the tool state before the queued pointer move is flushed
reason: The sole comment confirms #10762 changed the test to poll for the expected state after the asynchronous touch move is flushed.
assessment: Varve's canvas pipeline forwards pointer moves to the owning tool on the native pointer event rather than queueing them behind a later editor dispatch flush. The specific test timing race does not map to this implementation.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's canvas pipeline forwards pointer moves to the owning tool on the native pointer event rather than queueing them behind a later editor dispatch flush.

title: Mermaid export snapshots flake on nondeterministic rasterization of the exported SVG
reason: The sole comment disproves the fallback-font hypothesis and identifies screenshot capture sizing/rasterization as the common nondeterminism behind both Mermaid and foreign-object snapshot failures.
assessment: This is a tldraw examples export-snapshot harness issue involving its shared download-render-screenshot helper, not a demonstrated Varve SVG renderer or font-layout defect. Varve visual evidence uses a separate test harness and has no reproduction from the reported cases.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is a tldraw examples export-snapshot harness issue involving its shared download-render-screenshot helper, not a demonstrated Varve SVG renderer or font-layout defect.

title: Foreign objects export snapshot flakes on the downscaled tiled background image
reason: The sole comment relates this report to #10758 and points to a broader nondeterministic screenshot-capture helper rather than the image tile or font hypothesis alone.
assessment: The failing test depends on tldraw's HTML foreignObject export and shared snapshot-capture helper. Varve's vector export and visual harness are separate and no local snapshot flake is established by this report.

varveAssessment.assessment: The failing test depends on tldraw's HTML foreignObject export and shared snapshot-capture helper. Varve's vector export and visual harness are separate and no local snapshot flake is established by this report.

title: A11y style panel navigation e2e test appends text on every retry because Meta+a does not select all on Linux
reason: The issue describes a retry helper that uses macOS-only Meta+A on Linux, so each retry appends to the label instead of replacing it. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve's keyboard shortcut handling distinguishes the platform primary modifier and its text-edit/browser tests run in the local environment with Ctrl+A on Linux. The stated example-test failure is not an editor accessibility regression in Varve.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's keyboard shortcut handling distinguishes the platform primary modifier and its text-edit/browser tests run in the local environment with Ctrl+A on Linux.

title: Exit crop mode when clicking outside the shape being cropped
reason: Requests exiting crop on any canvas click outside the currently cropped shape, including another image or empty canvas; the same click should select the clicked shape without requiring a second click. No comments were available.
assessment: Fixed CropTool hit-testing so clicks on the active image leave crop mode unchanged, while outside clicks commit the crop, exit to select mode, and select the clicked node or clear selection on empty canvas. Three focused unit tests pass; the complete crop browser spec passed 12/12. The regression deliberately zooms out and clicks empty drawable canvas beyond ruler overlays. Before/after screenshots were visually inspected: crop handles and toolbar disappear after the click, the image remains intact, and no selection is left on empty canvas.

varveAssessment.assessment: Fixed CropTool hit-testing so clicks on the active image leave crop mode unchanged, while outside clicks commit the crop, exit to select mode, and select the clicked node or clear selection on empty canvas. Three focused unit tests pass; the complete crop browser spec passed 12/12. The regression deliberately zooms out and clicks empty drawable canvas beyond ruler overlays. Before/after screenshots were visually inspected: crop handles and toolbar disappear after the click, the image remains intact, and no selection is left on empty canvas.

title: VS Code extension: canvas fails to render in webview at load
reason: The report concerns the tldraw VS Code extension's Electron webview resolving packaged assets through an undefined VS Code URI service. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve does not ship a VS Code extension or a VS Code webview resource URI bridge. Its Tauri desktop and browser asset protocols are distinct from this extension packaging failure.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not ship a VS Code extension or a VS Code webview resource URI bridge.

title: Explore internal editor modules while preserving the public API
reason: Requests identifying internal module seams while preserving the tldraw public API; it is a speculative architecture exploration rather than a reported behavior defect. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve already has its own Rust/TypeScript package boundaries and modularization roadmap. The proposal's tldraw editor-manager seams and compatibility constraints should not be transplanted without a local architecture need.

title: Draw shape selection bounds and outline don't match the rendered stroke at sharp tips
reason: Reports a visible mismatch between sharp draw-stroke tips, the selection rectangle, and the blue geometry outline, but no source document or reproducible steps were available. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve derives path node bounds from control points and renders joins through its stroke renderer. A miter-tip mismatch is possible in principle, but no matching local artifact or browser reproduction has been established; retain as a visual parity check rather than changing shared geometry speculatively.

title: Computer image generation is broken
reason: Reports image generation failing on computer.tldraw.com without a reproduction or diagnostic detail. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve does not use the tldraw.com computer image-generation service. Its offline image-generation and model-provider paths are separate; the report contains insufficient information to identify a shared failure.
